# Story 17.2: Implement constant-time CSRF token comparison and unguessable session-id derivation

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want `validateStoredToken` to compare the presented token against `storedData.token` in constant time and `sessionId` derived from an unguessable server-issued value,
So that any request with only a live entry but a wrong or absent presented token is rejected (P0 item #4 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Story 17.1's red-phase tests pass: `validateStoredToken` compares the presented token to `storedData.token`, and a request with only a live (unexpired) stored entry but a WRONG or ABSENT presented token is REJECTED.
2. The comparison uses a constant-time primitive (`crypto.timingSafeEqual` or equivalent), so timing does not leak whether the prefix matched.
3. `sessionId` derives from an unguessable server-issued value instead of `sha256(ip-userAgent-minute)` — it no longer depends on client-supplied `ip`/`userAgent`/minute.
4. Existing legitimate flows still pass CSRF validation (a correct presented token matching the stored entry is accepted).
5. The previously-skipped tests from Story 17.1 are unskipped (`.skip()` removed) and pass under `nx test server`; the full server suite is green with no pre-existing test modified, weakened, or removed.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1–#4): Remove skip markers and confirm red.
  - [ ] 1.1 In the specs added by Story 17.1, remove every `it.skip` marker and run `nx test server`, confirming the new assertions FAIL against current code (red).
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #1, #2): Add constant-time token comparison to `validateStoredToken`.
  - [ ] 2.1 In `apps/server/src/app/middleware/validate-csrf-token.function.ts` (`validateStoredToken`, lines ~119–142), compare the presented token against `storedData.token` using a constant-time primitive (e.g., `crypto.timingSafeEqual`) and REJECT when they do not match or when no token is presented.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3): Derive `sessionId` from an unguessable server-issued value.
  - [ ] 3.1 In `apps/server/src/app/utils/generate-session-id.function.ts`, replace the `sha256(ip-userAgent-minute)` derivation with a server-issued unguessable value (e.g., `crypto.randomUUID()` or `randomBytes`), so the id no longer depends on client-supplied inputs.
  - [ ] 3.2 Update any consumer that relied on the old derivation (e.g., `validate-csrf-token.function.ts`) to work with the new id format, keeping it green.
- [ ] Task 4 (AC: #4): Preserve legitimate flows.
  - [ ] 4.1 Confirm a correct presented token matching the stored entry is still accepted; do not break existing valid CSRF flows.
- [ ] Task 5 (AC: #5): Confirm green suite.
  - [ ] 5.1 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with Story 17.1's tests now passing (unskipped).

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** `validateStoredToken` in `apps/server/src/app/middleware/validate-csrf-token.function.ts` (lines ~119–142) never compares the presented token to the stored one — it only checks an entry exists and is unexpired, so any request with a live entry passes. Separately, `generate-session-id.function.ts:4-13` derives `sessionId` from `sha256(ip-userAgent-minute)`, which is guessable/collidable. This is P0 item #4 from Aspect 9.
- **First task is always unskip → confirm red → implement.** The red-phase tests from Story 17.1 define the target; do not edit their assertions to make them pass, only the production code.
- **Constant-time compare:** use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` (or equivalent). Guard against differing-length inputs before calling it (e.g., hash both to a fixed length first) so you don't throw on length mismatch.
- **Session-id change ripples:** if you change how `sessionId` is derived, check every consumer (`validate-csrf-token.function.ts`, any cookie/header that carries the id) and keep them consistent + green.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/server/src/app/middleware/validate-csrf-token.function.ts` (`validateStoredToken` — constant-time compare, reject on mismatch/absent).
- Modify: `apps/server/src/app/utils/generate-session-id.function.ts` (unguessable server-issued id).
- Possibly modify: any consumer of the session id that relied on the old derivation.
- Modify: Story 17.1's specs (remove `.skip()` markers only — no assertion changes).
